# Dynatrace Component Release Tracking v2

A customer-ready release intelligence dashboard with SaaS-first visibility and component sections for OneAgent, ActiveGate, Operator, and EdgeConnect.

## What this dashboard answers
- What version is SaaS currently running?
- What is latest versus next-planned by component?
- What runtime versions are currently observed?
- Are sources healthy or degraded?
- What AI summary is available for the latest release rows?

1.title: SaaS Current Runtime Version
1.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | filter component == "saas" | sort observed_at desc | limit 1 | fields observed_version, observed_at, source_status

2.title: SaaS Release Rows (Latest and Next)
2.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter component == "saas" | fields released_version, is_latest, is_next_planned, release_url, source_status = release_status, fetched_at | sort is_latest desc

3.title: Release Freshness
3.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | summarize latest_release_fetch = max(fetched_at), release_rows = count()

4.title: Runtime Freshness
4.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize latest_runtime_observed = max(observed_at), runtime_rows = count()

5.content:
## OneAgent

Latest and next release rows, current runtime distribution, and AI summary for OneAgent.

6.title: OneAgent Release
6.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter component == "oneagent" | fields released_version, is_latest, is_next_planned, release_url, source_status = release_status, fetched_at | sort is_latest desc

7.title: OneAgent Runtime
7.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | filter component == "oneagent" | fields observed_version, running_count, source_type, source_status, observed_at, collection_message | sort observed_version desc

8.title: OneAgent Breaking and AI Summary
8.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_release_status" | filter component == "oneagent" and is_latest == "true" | fieldsAdd breaking_changes = if(breaking_changes_summary == "-" or breaking_changes_summary == "", "No breaking changes extracted yet.", else: breaking_changes_summary), ai_highlights = if(highlights_summary == "-" or highlights_summary == "", "No AI highlights extracted yet.", else: highlights_summary) | fields released_version, breaking_changes, ai_highlights, release_url, fetched_at

21.content:
## Source Health

Use this table to confirm ingestion health by component and quickly identify unavailable or not-configured sources.

22.title: Runtime Source Health by Component
22.query: load "/lookups/dt_component_runtime_versions" | summarize rows = count(), by: { component, source_status } | sort component asc, source_status asc
